## Description

<!-- Please discuss the changes you have worked on. What do the changes do; why is this PR needed? -->

Bump dependencies.

## Design

### Adaptive Cards and `swiper` package

<!-- If this feature is complicated in nature, please provide additional clarifications. -->

`adaptivecards@3.0.5` (latest) is depending on a vulnerable version of `swiper`. We are using `overrides` to bump to `swiper@12.1.2` while waiting for the maintainer to update their package.

```sh
# Modify package.json and add overrides

npm install adaptivecards --include-workspace-root -w packages/bundle
npm uninstall adaptivecards
```

This overrides will only work with bundle. It does not have any effects on NPM-installed version of Web Chat.

### Speech SDK authorization token

`microsoft-cognitiveservices-speech-sdk@1.17.0` prefer `authorizationToken` of `"Bearer XYZ"`.

However, in version 1.48.0, they prefer `authorizationToken` of `"XYZ"` (without "Bearer").

For smoother transition, we added code to help our developers to automatically strip "Bearer" off the authorization token.

## Specific Changes

<!-- Please list the changes in a concise manner. -->

- `npm run bump && npm dedupe`
- Added `npm dedupe` to `bump` script
- Pinned `react-wrap-with@0.1.0` until it resolve a compatibility issue with Preact
- Overrode `swiper@12.1.2`
- Strip "Bearer" prefix from speech authorization token
